newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania rollover T-bill issue fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Romania rollover T-bill issue fully subscribed.

text.p: An issue of 380 billion lei worth of Romanian floating-rate treasury bills was fully subscribed on Friday, latest central bank (BNR) data showed.

Seven banks -- Banc Post SA, Bancorex SA, Banca Romana pentru Dezvoltare SA, Casa de Economii si Consemnatiuni, Banca Agricola SA, Banca Comerciala Romana SA and Bankcoop SA -- and their clients have bought the paper.
The T-bills, which mature on April 17, offer an annual yield calculated as an average of the weekly auctioned credit rates during their life period.
The BNR's one-week rate soared to 59.23 percent at Thursday's auction, up from 53 percent in a previous session.
